descrição.p1: I am a Full Stack Developer with hands-on experience building web applications, APIs, automations, and integrations. I work primarily with React, TypeScript, .NET, Python, PHP/Laravel, and SQL databases, connecting well-structured frontends with organized backends and clear business rules.
descrição.p2: I am currently studying Artificial Intelligence at FIAP, where I apply data, Machine Learning, automation, and IoT in academic projects and practical solutions. I enjoy building products that move from concept to usable systems, with a focus on clarity, organization, usability, and continuous improvement.
descrição.p3: I have experience with projects in insurance, education, events, agrotech, dashboards, and digital platforms. My goal is to grow as a Full Stack Developer, expanding my expertise in Data and applied AI to create useful, scalable, and well-documented solutions.

unica.descrição:
I work on the development of Proteo, a platform for the insurance market, contributing to Claims, Policies, BCP, commission management, financial workflows, and integration modules.

On the backend, I work with .NET, APIs, microservices, automated workers, email delivery, and Insuremo integrations. On the frontend, I develop workflows in React with a focus on usability, business rules, and maintainability.

agenciam.descrição:
I worked on the maintenance and modernization of web and mobile systems, including projects using PHP, WordPress, React Native, and Flutter.

I contributed to the evolution of a room scheduling system and the restructuring of a legacy mobile application, helping create a more organized, reusable foundation ready for publication.

seteDeSetembro.descrição:
I worked in IT infrastructure support, configuring computers, networks, printers, and a local server, as well as organizing internal processes with SharePoint.

I also developed an internal extension management system, centralizing information and making it easier for employees to update and consult it.

dashowboard.descricao: DashowBoard is an open-source desktop application created to centralize project and service monitoring in a single dashboard. Through integrations with GitHub, Vercel, Railway, and Supabase, the application enables users to track deployments, incidents, resource statuses, and operational metrics. In this way, it helps developers visualize their environments in a more organized, local, and customizable way.

archbase.descricao: Archbase is an open-source CLI written in Go that makes code patterns and architecture rules explicit, reusable, and understandable by developers and AI agents. It enables teams to define patterns, rules, and local scopes, distribute them through registries, and expose architectural context via MCP, helping both people and agents produce code that follows each project's conventions.

bifrost.descricao: Bifrost is a platform focused on creating, showcasing, supporting, and funding projects. The solution connects people, creators, and companies through open participation, donations, partnerships, and sponsorships, bringing project discovery and different forms of collaboration into a single ecosystem.

mimimi.descricao: The MIMIMI Project uses Artificial Intelligence to promote students' emotional well-being. Through the anonymous sharing of feelings, the solution uses Natural Language Processing (NLP) to analyze their reports. In this way, it helps schools identify emotional patterns, detect warning signs, and direct students to appropriate support.

feteps.descricao: The FETEPS app is a mobile application developed to present, organize, and track the projects displayed at the Technological Fair of Centro Paula Souza. It allows students, teachers, and evaluators to easily access information about projects, schedules, results, and certificates, providing a practical and modern experience.

contato.descrição: I'm always interested in hearing about new projects and opportunities. Whether you have a question or just want to say hi, feel free to reach out!
